architecture-67-animation-registry.md.text:
# Architecture section 67 — CSS 2.2 property animation registry

Status: approved under standing delegated design authority (Q250).
All 90 screen properties have an entry below. This is a semantic design registry,
not 90 implemented animation tests or an expansion of authored CSS syntax.

## Combination dispatch

B = by computed value under retained Web Animations Appendix A, using each CSS22
computed representation below. Corresponding components interpolate/add/accumulate
by their value type; incompatible component types/counts or unequal discrete components
use D for the entire property. Do not assume repeatable-list behavior without a source
assigning it. The table uses the approved fixed reference set, not unretained newer
property modules. CSS22 syntax remains controlling.

D = discrete midpoint interpolation (start below 0.5, end otherwise), not additive.
Use Values4's non-additive fallback (retain the first operand); accumulation uses the
specified type procedure, otherwise addition. N = not animatable: no property effect;
report request ineligibility rather than silently substituting D. S = expand the CSS22
shorthand and dispatch to constituent entries, preserving their independent eligibility.
V = approved visibility exception: an endpoint visible remains visible for interior
progress; outside choose the nearer endpoint, and neither-visible uses D.
FW = legacy weight number interpolation rounded to nearest hundred, ties toward positive
infinity; addition sums, accumulation follows addition, final property range applies.
FS = normal becomes internal oblique 0 degrees, oblique without angle becomes 14 degrees
under the selected Fonts4 rule; compatible oblique angles combine numerically. Italic
is a distinct keyword and incompatible pairs use D. Authored angles remain prohibited.

Numbers, dimensions and percentages interpolate as weighted sums; addition sums compatible
components. Integer interpolation rounds nearest with halfway toward positive infinity.
Mixed length/percentage retains separate components when unresolved. Final combination
range checking uses the target context at computed/used stage; do not clamp intermediate
components early. Keywords auto/normal/none/invert are typed alternatives, not invented
numeric endpoints. Resolved colors use the approved gamma-encoded sRGB premultiplied-alpha
path, with zero-alpha inverse handling. Border widths preserve style-mandated zero and
important/suppression ordering. font-size preserves keyword resolution and its f32 domain.

Sources: [Web Animations types](../tmp/web-animations-1/index.html#animating-properties),
[legacy/default exceptions](../tmp/web-animations-1/index.html#animation-types),
[Values combination](architecture-20-numeric-animation.md),
[color bridge](architecture-21-color-animation.md), [fixed module audit](animation-registry-audit.md).
The visibility conflict is resolved by Q068. Display3 supplies N for display; Fonts4
supplies D for font-family/font-variant and FS for font-style. Other missing CSS22
animation labels use Appendix A's B default, not a guess from modern browser behavior.

## Complete per-property entries

Each entry's definition link supplies validity/range/computed-value details. Test ID
ANIM-<property> requires compatible endpoints, incompatible alternatives, midpoint,
extrapolation/final range, addition/accumulation or ineligibility, and dependency refresh.
Shorthands require longhand expansion/reset tests. A conservative full style/layout/paint
invalidation is selected for every changed presentation; later optimization may use the
primary owner after equivalence testing. This avoids missing cross-property effects.

# Iced widget capture and adapter matrix

Status: initial source-backed inventory and Q209 adapter categorization adopted
under delegated design authority. Individual adapters are not implemented or
qualified. This does not complete section 46.

## Inventory boundary and interpretation

The primary baseline is retained iced_widget 0.14.2, with iced_core 0.14.0. The
[root exports](../tmp/iced/iced_widget-0.14.2/src/lib.rs),
[helpers](../tmp/iced/iced_widget-0.14.2/src/helpers.rs), and
[declaration index](capture-declaration-index.md) are retained evidence. The index
is lexical discovery, not a count of widgets or a complete semantic API audit.
Module APIs and associated constructors must be included, not just root helpers.

Q209 adopts separate adapter categories for ordinary leaf/content widgets,
ordered-child widgets, semantic wrappers, structured composites, deferred views,
and explicit opaque custom widgets. Categories describe adapter responsibilities;
they do not change CSS applicability or permit ordinary widgets to become opaque
because capture is difficult. A native control's internal drawing/state is not
automatically a set of source children. Publicly supplied widget content must
retain its source identity, even inside a native helper returning Element.

Names below identify Rust API families. Except for previously approved canonical
names, this inventory does not yet assign final CSS names or default display
values; section 47 owns that registry. Child roles describe inspected constructor
inputs/storage, not an assertion that every argument already transports metadata.
All rows require constructor/builder classification and positive/negative capture
cases. No row is declared fully supported on the basis of this inventory.

## Ordinary content, controls, and drawing widgets

Paths below are relative to retained iced_widget/src unless stated otherwise.

| API family | Verified public input/content | Capture responsibility and outstanding evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text; text(); value(); text! | text.rs aliases core Widget Text; helpers.rs:1143 accepts IntoFragment; value converts ToString; text! formats tokens | Preserve text before CSS processing; formatting payload is not a widget child list. Borrowed versus owned fragments need cases. |
| text::Rich; rich_text(); rich_text! | text/rich.rs:50, helpers.rs:1194 and :205; spans are text Span values | Capture ordered spans as text content; do not assign a source element to every span implicitly. Text/link semantics coordinate with sections 47/53/58. |
| text::Span; span() | helpers.rs:1238; core text reexports | Content/configuration value, not independently a Widget constructor. |
| Checkbox; checkbox() | checkbox.rs:119 takes bool; stores optional label | Control state and label content; no application Element child in this constructor. Label builder classification required. |
| Radio; radio() | radio.rs:172 takes label, value, selection, FnOnce producing Message | Label and control data; callback produces a message, not a widget. Preserve callback timing. |
| Toggler; toggler() | toggler.rs:121 takes bool; stores optional label | Control data plus label builder; native internal drawing is not source structure. |
| TextInput; text_input() | text_input.rs:135 takes placeholder/value strings | Editable content and placeholder are distinct roles; editing/layout integration needs sections 57/58/61. |
| TextEditor; text_editor() | text_editor.rs:140 borrows Content<Renderer> | Borrow editor state without forcing static lifetime; content is not an Element child. |
| Slider; slider() | slider.rs:117 range/value and Fn(T) -> Message | Range/value/message callback; intrinsic/native control behavior separate from CSS geometry. |
| VerticalSlider; vertical_slider() | vertical_slider.rs:121 corresponding vertical control constructor | Same payload distinction; do not infer CSS orientation merely from display. |
| PickList; pick_list() | pick_list.rs:191 options, selection, on_select | Option data plus generated native menu; menu/source/overlay integration needs explicit policy. |
| ComboBox; combo_box() | combo_box.rs:168 state/placeholder/selection/callback; creates native TextInput internally | Composite control internals are not visible annotated construction; preserve public control semantics and qualify internal text/overlay treatment. |
| ProgressBar; progress_bar() | progress_bar.rs:79 range/value; vertical builder at :105 | Numeric control data, no Element child input; builder variant must be indexed. |
| Space; space(); space::horizontal/vertical | space.rs:13/:21/:36; size-only construction | Empty source content; CSS sizing overrides corresponding native hints under existing policy. |
| Rule; rule::horizontal/vertical | rule.rs:30/:42 take thickness | Orientation/thickness native configuration; CSS border/paint handling remains separate. |
| Image; image() | image.rs:74 handle | Replaced content; resource handle and intrinsic metrics, with image feature enabled. |
| image::Viewer | image/viewer.rs:28 handle | Image viewing interaction, not equivalent to static Image; include feature-specific adapter and interaction tests. |
| Svg; svg() | svg.rs:74 handle | Replaced SVG content; SVG feature; further constructors such as file/data acquisition need classification. |
| Canvas; canvas() | canvas.rs:162 program | Program-owned drawing payload, not an Element child; canvas feature. Preserve public drawing/input contract while CSS controls its outer box. |
| QRCode; qr_code() | qr_code.rs:77 borrows Data | Drawing data rather than child widgets; qr_code feature. Data::new is not a widget constructor. |
| Shader; shader() | shader.rs:34 program | Custom rendering payload; wgpu feature. Native backend availability is a separate verified capability, not a CSS exemption. |

## Child-bearing widgets and wrappers

| API family | Verified input/storage | Capture responsibility and outstanding evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Container; container() | container.rs:87, one Element-compatible content | One supplied source child; wrapping boxes inserted for CSS must not become new source elements. |
| center/center_x/center_y/right/right_center/bottom/bottom_center/bottom_right | helpers.rs:259–417 return Container with native alignment hints | Constructor aliases/recipes for Container; do not add both a helper node and a container node. Full chain effects still require indexing. |
| Button; button() | button.rs:106, content Element | Retain source child and button behavior; state/event integration cannot be reduced to padding wrappers. |
| Scrollable; scrollable() | scrollable.rs:93 and :100 content constructors | Source child with native scrolling behavior; CSS overflow/native ownership coordinate with sections 60/61. |
| Pin; pin() | pin.rs:70 content | One content child; native location hints must not silently override CSS positioning. |
| MouseArea; mouse_area() | mouse_area.rs:144 content | Child plus event callbacks; metadata/source routing must survive event wrapping. |
| Sensor; sensor() | sensor.rs:39 content | Child plus observation behavior and builder type changes; preserve measurement/event timing. |
| Themer; themer() | themer.rs:34 and helpers.rs:2020 take Option<Theme> and content | Child with native theme override; text_color/background builders store function pointers. CSS inheritance and native theming remain distinct mechanisms. |
| Float; float() | float.rs:31 content | Native floating wrapper; its name does not establish implementation of CSS float. |
| Tooltip; tooltip() | tooltip.rs:94 content and tooltip Elements plus Position | Distinct anchor/content and tooltip roles; source attachment and overlay timing need explicit design. |
| opaque() | helpers.rs:577 returns Element wrapping supplied content in private Opaque | This iced helper concerns native event behavior; it is not the architecture's opt-in opaque-custom-widget boundary. Supplied child remains managed. |
| hover() | helpers.rs:738 returns Element with private Hover holding base/top | Preserve two explicit input roles; cannot inspect private fields after erasure. Register a constructor recipe before calling opaque native conversion. |

## Ordered children, structured composites, and deferred construction

| API family | Verified construction | Capture responsibility and outstanding evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Row; row(); row!; row::Wrapping | row.rs:35/:60/:131/:148, Wrapping at :363 | Ordered child sequence, push/extend and wrapping variants; no native row-layout exemption from CSS. |
| Column; column(); column!; column::Wrapping | column.rs:35/:62/:140/:157, Wrapping at :375 | Ordered child sequence; inspect all child mutators and conversions. |
| Grid; grid(); grid! | grid.rs:13/:41/:100/:109/:121 | Ordered children including push_maybe; native grid is not CSS Grid syntax beyond CSS 2.2. |
| Stack; stack(); stack! | stack.rs:23/:47/:87/:107/:117 | Ordered children with push_under as a distinct mutator; source insertion order must match the selected contract. |
| keyed::Column; keyed_column() | keyed/column.rs:94/:145/:162/:175 | Key/child pairs, optional insertions, ordered extension. Align keys with approved sibling-scoped reconciliation; no unchecked identity reuse. |
| Table; table(); table::column() | table.rs:18/:34/:82; columns contain headers and Fn(T) -> Element; constructor materializes headers and cells | Structured composite recipe must retain header/row/cell roles before private storage erasure. The column descriptor is not itself a Widget. CSS table structure/defaults need sections 47/55. |
| PaneGrid; pane_grid() | pane_grid.rs:182 state plus view callback; constructor invokes callback while collecting contents | Callback is eager in this retained constructor, unlike Responsive. Capture body/title/controls roles and pane identity before erasure. |
| pane_grid::Content, TitleBar, Controls | content.rs:36/:45; title_bar.rs:38/:51; controls.rs:26/:38 | Structured builder values: body, optional title, controls with full/compact variants. Do not mistake these descriptors for independent arbitrary native widgets. |
| Responsive; responsive() | responsive.rs:39 stores Fn(Size) -> Element; layout :79 onward invokes it; diff defers | Deferred, size-dependent subtree. Needs coordinated source attachment/layout stages; cannot call it early solely to inspect children. |
| Lazy; lazy() | lazy.rs:46 stores dependency/view; requires View into Element<'static,...>; state/diff use dependency hash | Deferred/cached view; preserve actual static result constraint, dependency invalidation, and persistent child state. Library capture must not add static constraints to unrelated helpers. |
| Component; component() | lazy/helpers.rs:32 converts Component to Element; deprecated since iced 0.13 | Trait-based hidden view construction; requires annotated implementation/explicit capture integration or the approved explicit custom boundary, never silent ordinary-subtree opacity. |
| markdown()/markdown::view/view_with/item and Viewer methods | markdown.rs:1197 onward; helper reexport at helpers.rs:1246 | Structured helper family with hidden widget construction. Inventory all heading/list/table/code/image/link callbacks; a whole Markdown tree is not automatically opaque. |
| iced() logo helper | helpers.rs:1852 builds row with container/text before returning Element | A known composite recipe, not an independently introspectable Element. Capture its actual ordinary structure through a registered implementation. |

## Erasure, mapping, overlays, and custom entry points

- Element::new, From/Into conversions: capture must occur before erasure or receive
  an already captured Element. Arbitrary From implementations are not inferable
  widget constructors from token spelling alone.
- Element::map: retained core element.rs:268–285 forwards tag/state/children/diff.
  Treat message mapping as a transport operation, not an extra source element.
  This is source-level support for investigation; borrowed callback/state behavior
  still needs an executable probe.
- Element::explain: core element.rs:411–426 forwards the corresponding state
  hooks. Debug wrapping needs qualification without altering CSS source identity.
- overlay::menu and overlay Elements belong to the overlay API surface. They are
  not a complete list of ordinary Widget constructors and are not silently omitted
  from interaction/style coverage. Sections 48/61 must define their attachment.
- Action, IDs, style catalogs, state structs, image handles, and pane descriptors
  are public API but not all are widgets. A pub-declaration count is insufficient.
- Explicit custom widgets follow the approved single replaced-source boundary.
  A custom widget assembled from managed iced construction can instead supply the
  declared capture integration. Unknown ordinary construction must be diagnosed.

## Registry contract and verification handoff

Each final entry must record: exact invocation binding, constructor/descriptor
identity, supported contexts/features, source roles, builder transitions, child
insertion/removal order, content versus callback payloads, borrow constraints,
native state ownership, overlay/deferred behavior, CSS hint precedence, diagnostic
cases, and evidence status. Type names/defaults belong to section 47; state and
deferred ownership to 48; CSS layout to 52–61; public registration API to 71.

Q209 selects these categories and explicit role records over one generic
container wrapper or name-only constructor rewriting. Benefits: hidden composite
and deferred construction gaps stay visible. Cost: more adapter recipes and
qualification cases. This selection does not assert their feasibility is proven.

Remaining section-46 work: exhaustive builder/associated-constructor indexing;
function/helper alias binding and arbitrary call handling; actual registry loading
and extension protocol; capture grammar for values and control flow; and public
iced feasibility cases for metadata, borrows, mapped messages, and deferred content.

## Native filtering finding — Q211

Row/Column/Stack push can discard zero-size-hint children before native state
creation; from_vec and other families differ. See
[capture-child-retention.md](capture-child-retention.md). This is a concrete gap
in generic post-build wrapping: source capture must precede that discard.

Q227 adds [control wrapper builders](capture-control-builders.md): Button,
Scrollable, Tooltip and hover, with six native checks including conditional Into
conversion and direction-change history. Full adapter lowering remains open.

Q228 adds [PaneGrid descriptor roles](capture-pane-grid-roles.md), including
three native checks. Optional title omission can retain focus in native state;
explicit role removal must clear the declared slot before reintroduction.

N = normative-default direct section content under CSS §3.1, excluding scoped
notes/examples/illustrations and explicitly non-normative recommendations.
I = explicitly informative section/appendix. I-direct = only the text before

classification rules and must not be lost merely because they precede a heading.

At initial intake, every N/M region had clause extraction pending under the listed owners.
The continuation map below records later traversal; unresolved interpretation and
reference work remains open even for traversed chapters. I/S/R

## Source classification and selected scope

About §§1.2,1.3,1.5 and introductory tutorials/design principles are explicitly
informative. About §1.1 describes the relationship to prior CSS editions; it does
not import removed features. Its specimen property table is a documentation
template, not an additional property. Initial, inherited and computed table fields
retain the meanings supplied by their definitions and the cascade chapter.

The selected host parses the five page properties and preserves their cascade,
inheritance and computed values. It does not paginate. Page declarations remain a
separate context and never become element declarations. These are architecture
consequences of the existing parsing/applicability distinction in
[the property inventory](property-inventory.md), not a new printing commitment.
Actual parser and runtime behavior remains unqualified.

The canvas definition does not settle native-window backdrop transparency. Q273
remains pending in [questions](questions.md). Full imported-reference coverage,
source discrepancies and cross-clause interactions remain open.
